name: DTB Selector
description: Choose the panel device tree AnberNext boots: the normal one or the no-timing-change variant. Swaps rk3566-353v.dtb on the NEXTBOOT partition and reboots. Never touches the eMMC (Android) or the games card.
author: souhail

changelog.v0.1.0: First version: normal vs no-timing-change panel DTB, current selection detected, atomic write, reboot.
